scope: Source-conditioned developmental aperture-spectrum comparison; not a validated joint likelihood, independent discovery, or oscillator history test
v1_failure: Six evaluation apertures was an arbitrary planning minimum; actual metadata yields five. V1 failure retained, no response-based region expansion. V2 uses identical15 apertures and design-identifiability gates.

support.mask: Fixed geometric squares, no signal/emission threshold, all finite native voxels; any missing voxel fails adapter, never becomes zero
support.history: All regions historically exposed in earlier projects. These are algorithmic fitting/evaluation subsets only. Existing HI/CO maps contain same-observation velocity-selection dependence; no new independent holdout claim.

models: Newton plus softened logarithmic pair potential
gravity.origin: Parent execution030 pre-response physical choice, not dimensionless oscillator calibration
gravity.source: Same registered stellar+HI+CO density in each model; require converged Newton and log fields at emitting quadrature nodes, not interpolate sparse72field samples without validation

source.primary: NGC2976 f4 stars h=.1kpc, HI/CO h=.2kpc from spatial source bindings
source.missing_source_regions: Frozen annular fill and zero-fill comparison; neither missing nor clipped values count as observed zero
source.beams: Native source beams remain embedded; require common30arcsec-source smoothing sensitivity propagated to predicted spectra; this is source-resolution sensitivity, not deconvolution or unique3D recovery
source.source_radius: Use full frozen mass support to6kpc plus tails audit, evaluate apertures only0.75..2.5kpc

pressure.force: HI-density-weighted azimuthal radial force integrated through z, not total-matter weighted or unqualified midplane force
pressure.gradient: Positive HI column from source only; Gaussian physical smoothing.25kpc before derivative, compare derivative numerical spacing halved; support/tails retained
pressure.negative_vphi2: Keep signed result and report no steady circular solution, no clamping or dropping those apertures
restrictions: zero mean radial and vertical flow
HI phase treated separately from molecular gas
prescribed vertical source; no general vertical equilibrium proven
pressure.line_width: Supporting dispersion is a fixed sensitivity, not identified with fitted spectral width; no instrument/beam broadening counted as pressure

fit.optimizer: float64 least_squares; only converged starts, minimum training mean patch loss; all starts and bound contacts retained
fit.objective: mean over10 training apertures of r^T C_ap^-1 r/42
fit.training_design: Before any evaluation response access: finite-difference Jacobian in scaled parameters must have rank3, smallest/largest singular ratio>1e-6; unsupported parameters fail, no posthoc fixing from evaluation. Analytic synthetic manufactured profiles pass parameter/forecast recovery controls first.
fit.line_prediction: Finite native-channel integral and per-channel width, not point sampling. Stellar/CO maps supply force, HI source supplies emission. NativeJy/beam to mJy/beam exact1000 conversion.
fit.all_source_inversions: source-image arrays may use all fixed projected map pixels; this conditions on the same-observation source and does not establish independent motion prediction

instrument.native_beam: Read unique IMAGR HISTORY AIPS CLEAN beam, not absent BMAJ keywords. Elliptical restoring beam, signed axes, finite halo/convolution before aperture averaging.
instrument.spectral: Use saved A and three H branches; source line extends across parent64channels including continuum-fit channels before crop to42. Native delivered data already processed: never apply continuum/spectral operator to it again.
instrument.ordering: NGC2976 radio velocities decrease. Sort only with matching row/column/data permutation and reverse output exactly. NGC3198 has FREQ Hz; separate rest-frequency radio conversion required.
instrument.flux: Standard CLEAN cube is not moment-map flux-rescaled cube. Need a bounded source-to-standard-cube amplitude transfer test; global scale does not certify spatially varying dirty/CLEAN residual response.
instrument.foreground: No Galactic velocity channel exclusion. Existing metadata supports only hypothesis, not diagnosed mask; retain every channel and report channel-resolved discrepancies.

noise.aperture: C_ap=sum_b sum_k (A U_k)^2 p_k C_b, native12x12 aperture embedded centrally in24x24 DCT support; mJy units
noise.mean: Western per-channel mean only, not local/evaluation residual subtraction
noise.uncertainty: Fixed working covariance plus western-core leave-one-core refit sensitivity with frozen recipe; no eastern selection. No assumption of independence among5evaluation apertures.
noise.score: Unconditioned marginal residual prediction: no held-channel noise interpolation from training residuals. Report all5paired losses and arithmetic mean difference; raw RMSE and channel spectra alongside covariance weighted losses.
noise.inference: No chi-square or binomial significance, p-values, confidence interval or sum-logpdf claimed as a calibrated joint galaxy likelihood. Descriptive result remains valid as conditional discrepancy with approximate weights.

controls.numerical: Independent source-to-spectra quadrature/beam/spectral replay; profile L1 refinement<1%, centroid difference<.5km/s, mass closure<1e-8; force own convergence gate must pass first
controls.noise_transfer: Existing outer-background validation supplies working weights; need pre-response injection adapter replay through exact aperture shape and all three response branches, actual background and manufactured covariance. No perfectlikelihood demand.
controls.kinematic_adequacy: Run separate fixed synthetic warp(+10deg inclination,+20deg PA), radialstream20km/s and asymmetricemission.4 controls with the same native adapter. On training data compare prescribed-rotation expanded kinematic model, retaining all training residual diagnostics. It is an adequacy check only, not a force-equilibrium model.
controls.attribution: If source/pressure/instrument branches reverse model preference or expanded motions are needed, report unresolved conditional comparison, not evidence for gravity. Nonaxisymmetric source force is measured and reported; do not pretend annular-average closure predicts full vector response.

access: Freeze compiled model predictions, source case hashes, optimizer controls and training-fit receipts before evaluation spectra are materialized. Independent evaluator prohibits any evaluation-dependent source, nuisance, channel, mask or branch change; future changes get a new developmental protocol, never a fresh-holdout label.
